Summary

 Position Summary 

Workday SCM- Senior Consultant Functional Transformation

Enterprise Performance

Our Enterprise Performance team helps clients enable large-scale business transformation through leading enterprise platforms and industry-informed strategies. Working across supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and IT operations, the team supports organizations in improving performance, modernizing processes, and adopting technology solutions that advance business objectives.

As part of this team, a Workday SCM Consultant will work with professionals experienced in supply chain transformation, process design, technology enablement, and implementation delivery. Together, the team helps clients design and deploy scalable Workday solutions that strengthen operational efficiency, support business growth, and deliver long-term value.

Level: Senior Consultant or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

Work you'll do

As a Sr Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will support Workday Supply Chain Management implementations across the project lifecycle.

• Analyze client requirements for supply chain processes, including procurement, inventory, sourcing, receiving, and order management.
• Support functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization for Workday Supply Chain Management solutions.
• Collaborate with client stakeholders and onsite/offshore teams to document business processes, solution requirements, test scenarios, and functional decisions.
• Support reporting, issue resolution, data validation, and defect tracking to help deliver high-quality implementation outcomes.
• Work with integration and cross-functional teams to support end-to-end process design and delivery aligned to client objectives.

The team

Enterprise Performance

Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.

The Emerging ERP Solutions offering provides advice, planning, and implementation of Cloud ERP solutions like Workday, MS Dynamics and Infor, featuring built-in industry-specific capabilities. The USI team plays a crucial role throughout the entire engagement lifecycle, from initial pursuits to final delivery. Specializing in Financials and Supply Chain transformations, the team also implements Adaptive Planning Solutions across various industries. Their deep expertise in both technology and domain ensures effective, tailored solutions that drive value and operational excellence for clients.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

Qualifications

Required:

• 6–10 years of consulting or industry experience with enterprise resource planning, cloud enterprise applications, or supply chain transformation
• Experience in at least 1 full life cycle enterprise resource planning implementation
• Experience with supply chain business processes such as Procure-to-Pay, inventory management, sourcing, receiving, order-to-cash, or project budgets and billing
• Experience supporting functional design, configuration, testing, and deployment in Workday Supply Chain Management or enterprise platforms such as Oracle, PeopleSoft, or SAP
• Experience with cloud-based Software as a Service (SaaS) and Platform as a Service (PaaS) solutions
• Proficiency in Microsoft Visio and Microsoft PowerPoint
• BE, BTech, MCA, or MSc in Computer Science, or equivalent, from an accredited university

Preferred:

• Active Workday certification
• Master’s degree with a finance, supply chain, or operations specialization

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.

The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.

What you'll do

As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.
  • Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.
  • Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.
  • Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.
  • Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.
  • Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.
  • Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.
  • Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.
  • Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.
  • Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.

You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.

Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.
  • Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.
  • Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.
  • Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.
  • Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.
  • Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.

Preferred qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.
  • Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.
  • Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.
  • Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.
  • Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.
